incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#12345 for service=autoscaler-controller (severity: high)
PagerDuty: page sent to /eng-oncall (rotation: primary)
maria (oncall): ack
maria (oncall): getting a big queue backlog on inference-hotpath, queue depth ~12k, 99th latency spiking to 6s, error rate ~4%
oliver (sre): seeing same in grafana https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/autoscaler - CPU headroom low, scale controller reconciliation lagging
maria (oncall): runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/autoscaler-backlog - attempting quick mitigations
sre-runbook-bot: Suggested play: 1) manual scale controller, 2) enable short-term burst pool, 3) route low-priority traffic to fallback model
maria (oncall): running manual scale: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment/autoscaler-controller --replicas=6`
maria (oncall): `kubectl get pods -n infra | grep autoscaler` -> new pods pending due to node quota
jay (platform): I can try bumping nodepool autoscaler limits, filing cloud quota increase now (ticket CLOUD-987)
oliver (sre): temp mitigation: divert non-critical requests with header `x-traffic-class: background` to dedupe pool (patching route)
maria (oncall): applied routing rule (commit abc123), restarted router shard: `systemctl restart rw-router@2`
maria (oncall): queue depth fell from 12k -> 5.2k in 4m, latency 99p down to 3.2s
jay (platform): cloud provider approved +2 nodes, start provisioning (ETA ~6m)
maria (oncall): once nodes join, autoscaler should finish warmup; monitoring warmup KV cache behavior
oliver (sre): note: KV cache warmup causes transient CPU spike, plan: stagger pod readiness using `--kvcache-warmup-delay` flag in next rollout
sre-runbook-bot: Documenting steps taken to incident ticket INC-2026
maria (oncall): PD ack -> escalated to platform lead for quota; overriding autoscaler to accept new nodes with `--max-pods=12` temporary
nisha (oncall): joining handoff, summary: backlog 12k -> manual routing + cloud nodes -> 900 in-flight -> monitoring. No customer-facing errors beyond latency spikes but we saw some 503s during restart window
maria (oncall): ng: observed roughly 1200 requests failed for customers during the 2m spike window; flagged to support for outreach if needed
jay (platform): follow-up: create ticket to add autoscaler pre-warm logic and limit thundering warmups, assigned to eng-runtime
oliver (sre): recommend postmortem checklist: validate scale controller metrics, add alerts for reconcilation-lag > 30s, and a play for background routing automation
PagerDuty: PD#12345 acknowledged by maria (oncall) at 8036543225
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation to platform on-call at 8036543280
maria (oncall): stepping back after manual mitigations, handing to nisha for monitoring and wrap-up
incident-bot: Handoff recorded -> next-oncall: nisha (oncall)
nisha (oncall): ack handoff, will monitor for 1h, will escalate if queue >2k again or error rate >1%
PagerDuty: PD#12345 resolved at 8036543448 (resolved by maria)
nisha (oncall): closing notes: final queue depth 310, latency stabilized ~0.9s, filing follow-up RFC for warmup gating and autoscaler tuning
maria (oncall): thanks all :thumbsup: - I'll add the timeline to INC-2026 and coordinate postmortem meeting
